mapper.insert: insert ignore into notification_delivery_receipt (event_type, event_id, recipient_id, channel, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{eventType}, #{eventId}, #{recipientId}, #{channel}, 'PENDING', now(), now())
mapper.update: update notification_delivery_receipt set status=#{status}, provider_code=#{providerCode}, update_time=now() where event_type=#{eventType} and event_id=#{eventId} and recipient_id=#{recipientId} and channel=#{channel} and status='PROCESSING'
